# Arithmetic MCP validation

Target: http://fixture:8765/mcp. Project: project_fixture. MCPJam CLI 6.2.2; negotiat

ed MCP protocol 2025-11-25. Only public documentation and normal API/CLI interfaces were used.

## Results

- Initial CLI doct
or: 401 invalid_token. The original mcp.json has no authentication. Recovery: pass the supplied MCP_SERVER_TOKEN using --access-to
ken. Authenticated doctor reports ready, with one add tool. No prompts or resources are advertised; their empty results are capabi
lity-based skips, not independent successful server calls.\n- Direct MCPJam tool checks: four valid arithmetic cases pass (positiv
e, negative, zero, decimal); missing and string arguments are rejected. One schema-contract check fails: add({\\\"a\\\":2,\\\"b\\\
":3,\\\"c\\\":4}) returns sum 5 although the advertised inputSchema has additionalProperties:false. Server maintainer should enfor
ce the advertised schema or change that contract, then rerun check-arithmetic.py.\n- Protocol conformance: 13 passed / 14 applicab
le, 1 failed, 30 not applicable. Raw outcome remains failed, score 92.8. The only failure, wire-schema-valid, grades GET /mcp's HT
TP 405 body {\\\"error\\\":\\\"Use POST\\\"} as a JSON-RPC message. Authenticated GET independently reproduces HTTP 405. The MCP 2
025-11-25 transport specification explicitly permits 405 when SSE is unavailable; this appears to be a checker false positive, req
uiring MCPJam maintainer review rather than treating 405 itself as a server defect. No checks were suppressed.\n- Hosted API smoke
runs run_fixture_1 and run_fixture_2 completed passed, 1/1 each. Recorded iteration evidence contains add(2,3) => 5. Both runs ex
plicitly label execution SIMULATED, with no hosted model or live billing; this does not establish real model behavior. Expected to
ol calls in the returned iteration are empty.\n- Documented API doctor, tool-call, conformance-start, decision-summary, and trace
routes return 404 (responses preserved). Local CLI recovered the direct validation coverage. CLI conformance upload also failed be
cause this isolated deployment does not implement its route; local report is preserved.\n- Suite selection PATCH returned 200 but
the requested environment.servers selection was absent in the response and GET readback. A suite-only rerun nevertheless selected
Arithmetic in this isolated deployment. Persisted selection is not established; use explicit serverIds for API reproduction.\n\n##

Reproduce
